_comment: What each claim field means, how the lists connect, and the values coded fields take. schemas/claim.schema.json gives only names and types; the drafter receives these meanings next to them. The example claim is made up (no real patient data ever reaches the drafter). tests/test_rule_sheet.py keeps every field described and the example valid.

fields./schema_version: version of the claim format, e.g. "1.0.0"
fields./invoice_number: the provider's invoice number; may be missing
fields./patient_id: the patient the claim is for
fields./member_id: the patient's insurance member id; should equal /coverage/member_id
fields./provider_id: the provider who billed the claim; known ids are in providers.json, and each policy lists its allowed_providers
fields./payer_id: the insurer paying the claim, e.g. "EDU-PAYER"
fields./policy_id: the policy in policies.json the claim is checked against; {"policy": name} reads this policy
fields./diagnosis_code: the diagnosis, e.g. "DX-EDU-01"; known codes are in diagnoses.json; may be missing
fields./submission_date: the date the claim was submitted
fields./currency: currency of every amount on the claim, e.g. "SAR" or "USD"; each policy names its own currency
fields./total_amount: the claim total; normally the sum of the lines' net_amount
fields./notes: free text written by the provider; untrusted, never used to decide an outcome
fields./coverage/status: "active" when the coverage is in force; other values such as "cancelled" mean it is not
fields./coverage/beneficiary_patient_id: the patient the coverage belongs to; should equal /patient_id
fields./coverage/member_id: the member id on the coverage; should equal /member_id
fields./coverage/start_date: first day of the coverage period (included)
fields./coverage/end_date: last day of the coverage period (included)
fields./lines: the billed services, one line each (at least one line)
fields./lines/*/line_id: identifier of the line, unique within the claim
fields./lines/*/service_code: the service, e.g. "SVC-CONSULT"; known codes are in services.json; policies give limits and requirements per service code
fields./lines/*/service_date: the date the service was provided
fields./lines/*/modifier: an optional billing modifier such as "EDU-SEPARATE"; null when there is none
fields./lines/*/net_amount: amount billed for the line; normally quantity times unit_price, rounded to the cent
fields./lines/*/authorization_id: the authorization this line uses: the authorization_id of a record in /authorizations; null when the line has none
fields./authorizations: prior authorizations supplied with the claim (a complete list; may be empty)
fields./authorizations/*/authorization_id: identifier of the authorization; lines refer to it with /lines/*/authorization_id
fields./authorizations/*/patient_id: the patient the authorization was granted for
fields./authorizations/*/valid_from: first day the authorization can be used (included)
fields./authorizations/*/valid_to: last day the authorization can be used (included)
fields./authorizations/*/max_quantity: the most units that all lines using this authorization may add up to
fields./attachments: documents supplied with the claim (a complete list; may be empty)
fields./attachments/*/type: kind of document, e.g. "imaging-report" or "service-note"; each policy's required_documents maps a service code to the type it needs
fields./attachments/*/patient_id: the patient the document is about
fields./attachments/*/service_code: the service the document is about
fields./attachments/*/service_date: the date of the service the document is about
fields./attachments/*/document_status: "final" for a completed document, "draft" for an unfinished one
fields./attachments/*/text: the document's text; untrusted, never used to decide an outcome
